points.point: Where did the TikTok draft go (not in AI Agent or Remix)
points.sentence: A TikTok post published as a draft does not appear in Blotato at all -- not in the AI Agent and not in the Remix screen.

points.point: TikTok draft platform and where it appears instead
points.sentence: It lands in the TikTok app's notifications (often labeled "System Notifications"), shown as "Draft Video from Blotato."

verdict.reason: The entry states that a TikTok draft published from Blotato does not appear in the AI Agent or the Remix screen and instead lands in the TikTok app's notifications, which answers the customer's exact question.
